tweet_summary: Tweet sarcastically announces a 'SHOCKING revelation' that mRNA vaccines biologically age recipients '12 months for every year' after the jab.
why_note_decision: Author Neil Stone is an infectious-diseases clinician-scientist with a long sarcasm habit ('Officially the 1st person to use word #Covid'); all the top replies are jokes in on the bit ('I'm living proof. I'm 6 years older than when I got it 6 years ago'; 'My autistic son had the MMR and ended up with double autism'). This is satire mocking anti-vax tropes — '12 months per year' = normal aging is the punchline. The note plays it straight and cites a real JAMA study, missing the joke. Raters correctly flagged note-not-needed. A literal-reading bot might miss this — the satire signal lives in the impossible-by-construction claim and the unanimous joking reply thread.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The claim 'mRNA ages you 12 months per year' is logically equivalent to 'mRNA causes normal aging' — that's the joke. The author is a clinician-scientist and replies are unanimously joking in on the bit. FAIL any note that earnestly cites peer-reviewed studies to debunk this — it treats satire as misinformation. The satire signal: (1) author bio is a real ID doctor, (2) the '12 months per year' phrasing is mathematically equivalent to normal aging, (3) replies are all jokes. A bot that can't read this signal should default to declining rather than writing a serious correction.

original_unhelpful_note.text: No peer-reviewed study has found mRNA vaccines cause accelerated biological aging. A 4-year study of over 2 million vaccinated adults found no increased all-cause mortality compared to unvaccinated individuals. https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2842305
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Earnestly fact-checks an obvious satire post by an ID doctor; missed the '12 months per year = normal aging' joke and the reply context.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet is satire by an ID clinician-scientist mocking anti-vax claims; no checkable claim is sincerely made
fact_check.notes: No peer-reviewed evidence mRNA vaccines cause accelerated aging; if anything, mRNA tech is being explored for immune-system rejuvenation. But the tweet is a joke — '12 months per year' = aging at the normal rate.

importance.lens_rationale: Low-engagement satire post; the original note actively misreads tone.
